name: Mobile inline contract PDF signing
type: AM Platform / contracts / mobile protected-document reader
scope: Render the protected frozen PDF inside the signing page on Android LINE
Unlock Party A or Party B consent only after the exact document loads successfully
Persist the review marker for the same browser session and frozen document hash
Open the complete fragment-token signing URL through LIFF when an external browser is requested
Remove the about:blank and protected Blob navigation flow

dataIsolation.guard: The PDF stays behind the existing token, LIFF identity, group-membership, signer-role, and frozen-document checks; only a session-scoped reviewed flag is stored in the browser.

definitionOfDone: Android LINE displays every protected PDF page without opening about:blank
The applicable consent and submit controls unlock after successful inline document loading
External-browser handoff retains the fragment token without using a query string
Party A, Party B, and read-only group-member authorization remain unchanged
Production serves the bundled same-origin PDF.js assets
